products.name: Besan Ladoo
products.description: Traditional sweet made with roasted gram flour and pure ghee
products.detailedDescription: A traditional Indian sweet made with roasted gram flour and pure ghee. Our Besan Ladoos are crafted using a generations-old recipe, where besan is carefully roasted to achieve the perfect golden color and nutty aroma. Each ladoo is hand-rolled to ensure perfect texture and consistency.
products.servingSuggestion: Best enjoyed with a glass of warm milk or as an evening snack.
products.storageInfo: Store in an airtight container. Stays fresh for up to 15 days at room temperature.

products.name: Green Moong Ladoo
products.description: Healthy and nutritious ladoo made with green moong dal
products.detailedDescription: A healthy twist on traditional ladoos, made with sprouted green moong dal and natural sweeteners. These ladoos are a perfect blend of taste and nutrition, making them an ideal healthy snack option for all age groups.
products.servingSuggestion: Perfect as a morning snack or post-workout energy boost.
products.storageInfo: Keep refrigerated for extended shelf life. Stays fresh for up to 20 days.

products.name: Dinka Ladoo
products.description: Special ladoo made with premium ingredients
products.detailedDescription: Traditional winter special ladoos made with edible gum and dry fruits. These ladoos are particularly popular during winter months and are known for their warming properties and health benefits.
products.servingSuggestion: Consume 1-2 ladoos daily during winter months.
products.storageInfo: Store in a cool, dry place. Stays fresh for up to 2 months.

products.name: Groundnut Ladoo
products.description: Nutritious ladoo made with roasted groundnuts
products.detailedDescription: A protein-rich sweet made with freshly roasted groundnuts and organic jaggery. Our groundnut ladoos are made in small batches to ensure freshness and maintain the perfect crunch of roasted peanuts.
products.servingSuggestion: Enjoy as a pre-workout snack or with evening tea.
products.storageInfo: Store in an airtight container. Best consumed within 20 days.

products.name: Rawa Ladoo
products.description: Delicate ladoo made with roasted semolina
products.detailedDescription: Light and delicious ladoos made with roasted semolina and fresh coconut. These ladoos have a unique texture and are perfect for those who prefer lighter sweets.
products.servingSuggestion: Best enjoyed with afternoon tea or as a light dessert.
products.storageInfo: Keep in airtight container. Fresh for up to 10 days.

products.name: Til (Sesame) Ladoo
products.description: Healthy ladoo made with roasted sesame seeds
products.detailedDescription: Traditional winter special ladoos made with roasted sesame seeds and jaggery. These ladoos are not just delicious but also packed with the goodness of sesame seeds and natural sweetness of jaggery.
products.servingSuggestion: Consume during winter mornings or evenings.
products.storageInfo: Stays fresh for up to 1 month when stored properly.

products.name: Ragi Ladoo
products.description: Nutritious ladoo made with finger millet flour
products.detailedDescription: Healthy and nutritious ladoos made with finger millet flour and enriched with dry fruits. These ladoos are a perfect combination of taste and health, especially beneficial for growing children and women.
products.servingSuggestion: Best consumed as breakfast or evening snack.
products.storageInfo: Store in cool, dry place. Stays fresh for up to 15 days.

products.name: Methi Ladoo
products.detailedDescription: Traditional medicinal ladoos made with fenugreek seeds and wholesome ingredients. These ladoos are particularly beneficial for new mothers and those looking for health benefits along with taste.
products.servingSuggestion: Take 1-2 ladoos daily, preferably in the morning.
products.storageInfo: Keeps well for up to 1 month in airtight container.

products.name: Murmura Chivda
products.description: Crispy snack made with puffed rice
products.detailedDescription: A light and crunchy snack made with puffed rice and a perfect blend of spices. Our Murmura Chivda is made fresh in small batches to maintain its signature crunchiness and flavor.
products.servingSuggestion: Perfect with evening tea or as a light snack.
products.storageInfo: Stays crispy for up to 15 days in airtight container.

products.name: Avalakki Chivda
products.description: Flattened rice snack with nuts and spices
products.detailedDescription: A traditional South Indian snack made with flattened rice and a special blend of spices. Our Avalakki Chivda is known for its perfect balance of spices and crunchiness.
products.servingSuggestion: Can be enjoyed dry or mixed with onions and tomatoes.
products.storageInfo: Maintains freshness for up to 20 days when stored properly.

products.name: Chakli
products.description: Spiral-shaped crispy snack made with rice flour
products.detailedDescription: A spiral-shaped crispy snack made with a perfect blend of rice flour and spices. Our Chaklis are hand-crafted to achieve the perfect spiral shape and crispiness that lasts longer.
products.servingSuggestion: Best enjoyed with hot tea or coffee.
products.storageInfo: Stays crispy for up to 1 month in airtight container.
